drawings.description: un cercle, un diamètre horizontal tracé avec son centre, et, de l'extrémité droite du diamètre, une flèche vers un point du cercle en haut : peut-être le cercle unité où vivent les $\lambda_i$.
drawings.notes: An oval circle, a horizontal diameter with its centre marked, and from the right end of the diameter a heavily inked arrow to a point of the circle at the top.

drawings.description: à gauche, un petit croquis en zigzag : un trait vertical et une ligne brisée qui y revient, avec des marques ($\tau_0$ près de l'angle inférieur).
drawings.notes: The long vertical stroke (heavy, slightly wavy) and the broken line coming back to it, every branch ending on it at a computed point: from the corner tau_0 (lower left) a long line up to the right, a small zigzag back down to the left, then up to meet the vertical near its top; from the same corner a second line up to the right meeting the vertical lower down; from the corner a line continuing down to the left, and the hook below the corner. Also the thin stroke crossing the vertical in its upper part and the two short ticks (top and right of the lower meeting point). Label tau_0 at \small. Still differs: the small marks along the upper branch (a sign like a tau, a short heavy stroke) and the loop where the lower line reaches the vertical are not legible and are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (maths): the sign on the upper branch has the shape of the tau of tau_0 at the lower corner, with a short heavy stroke as its index; the schema lower on the page labels its strokes tau_0, tau_1, ..., so it is read tau_1 and is now drawn there. The loop where the lower line reaches the vertical stays left out. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): re-read on millimetre grids of the scan rendered at 400 dpi in colour (7-18 px a unit); not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script and laid over the crop; every stroke now lies on its ink within about 1 unit. Added, as they are on the page: the loop where the lower line reaches the vertical, and the curve that leaves it, runs down beside the vertical and joins it lower down (read at 18 px a unit; it was left out as illegible); the small heavy ring at the lower corner; the gap in the vertical just above the loop (its heavy upper part stops there, the thinner lower part starts below). Corrected: the lower line from the corner ends at the loop, with a separate thin stroke rising from there; the hook below the corner goes 4 units lower than drawn before. The labels tau_0 and tau_1 as settled on 12 November.

drawings.description: un schéma en zigzag sur deux rangées : en haut $L_0$, $L_1$, \ldots, $L_i$, $L_{i+1}$ ; en bas $L'_0$, $L'_1$, $L'_2$, \ldots, $L'_i$, $L'_{i+1}$ ; des traits obliques relient chaque $L_i$ à $L'_i$ et $L'_{i+1}$, marqués $\tau_0$, $\tau_1$, \ldots, $\tau_i$ ; à gauche un $L_0$ et un $L'_0$ surchargés ; à droite, après un trait vertical, $\beta_i$.
drawings.notes: Top row L_0, L_1, L_i, L_{i+1}, bottom row L'_0, L'_1, L'_2, L'_i, L'_{i+1}, labels at \small, re-read on two zoomed views (the bbox is extended downwards so that the bottom row is not cut). Each oblique stroke is drawn on the line joining the centres of the two labels it connects: L_0 to L'_0 (tau_0) and to L'_1, L_1 to L'_1 (tau_1) and to L'_2, L_i to L'_i (tau_i) and to L'_{i+1}, L_{i+1} to L'_{i+1}; on the left the overinked L_0 and L'_0 with their stroke (tau_0); on the right the long vertical stroke and beta_i. Left out: the struck label on the stroke from L_0 to L'_1 (a struck tau), the overwriting scribbles of the left L_0 and L'_0, and the fan of doubled strokes from L_i to L'_{i+1} (one stroke drawn). Still differs: the dots of the transcription (L_1, ..., L_i and L'_2, ..., L'_i) are not on the page; only a single dot between L_i and L_{i+1}, not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the top row reads L_0, L_1, L_i, L_{i+1} and the bottom row L'_0, L'_1, L'_2, L'_i, L'_{i+1} with no dots of ellipsis between them; the only dot stands between L_i and L_{i+1}. The redraw stands. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): re-read on millimetre grids of the scan rendered at 400 dpi in colour (27 px a unit); not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script and laid over the crop; every stroke and label now lies on its ink within about 1 unit. Moved onto their ink (1 to 2 units): the stroke tau_0 at the left, the two strokes from the second L_0, the stroke from L_1 to L'_1 (shorter, with the dot that starts it) and the label tau_1, the stroke from L_i to L'_i (with its small hook at the top) and the stroke from L_{i+1}. The fan of doubled strokes from L_i towards L'_{i+1} is now drawn as its three strokes instead of one. Left out as before, as struck or crossing-out: the struck tau on the stroke from L_0 to L'_1 and the overwriting strokes of the left L_0 and L'_0 (the long thin stroke rising from L_0 and the S-shaped stroke through L'_0); the single dot between L_i and L_{i+1} stays undrawn, as settled on 12 November.

drawings.description: deux croquis de rayons issus d'un point : le premier, trois demi-droites marquées $\tau_0$, $\tau_1$, $\tau_2$ ; le second, trois demi-droites marquées $\sigma$, $\rho_1$, $\rho_0$, avec de petites flèches courbes de rotation entre elles.
drawings.kind: two fans of rays from a point
drawings.notes: Above: three half-lines from a point, tau_0 (upwards, arrow), tau_1, tau_2 (to the right, arrow). Below: three heavier half-lines from a point, marked sigma, rho_1, rho_0, with small curved rotation arrows between them.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un petit segment gradué « $i \geqslant 2$, $i-1$, $i$ », deux arcs joignant les points voisins
drawings.notes: In the margin: "i >= 2", a horizontal segment, a dot at i-1, a short thick stroke and a tick, i at the right; two arcs below joining neighbouring points. The label above i-1 reads only as an i on the crop; i-1 after the transcription.

drawings.description: un segment horizontal gradué, des points et de petits traits, les premiers repères notés $c_1, c_2, c_3$, le dernier $c_n$ ; en dessous, un « C » isolé
drawings.notes: A horizontal segment with ticks and dots: the first marks c_1, c_2, c_3, two heavier dots, a gap with dots, a second piece, dots, and c_n at the right end; below on the left an isolated C. A dot below the start of the line is drawn as on the page.

drawings.description: un segment gradué de $1$ à $n$, le point $k$ marqué
drawings.notes: A segment from 1 to n with the point k marked by a tick; a small dot just right of 1 is drawn as on the page.

drawings.description: en haut à gauche, trois droites : $H_0$ et $H_1$, et une troisième qui les coupe ; un point $h_0$ sur celle-ci, un point $h_1$ à l'intersection de $H_0$ et de cette droite
drawings.notes: Three lines: H_0 (steep, from top right), H_1 (nearly horizontal, labelled at its right end), and a third line descending from the top left which carries the point h_0 and meets H_0 at the point h_1. Two small ticks on the third line near its crossing with H_1 are drawn.

drawings.description: deux rangées de sommets : en haut $a_{-1}, a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{n-1}, a_n$ (une accolade $V$ au-dessus de $a_0, \ldots, a_n$ ; un astérisque sur $a_1$), en bas $a'_0, a'_1, a'_2, \ldots, a'_{n-1}, a'_n, a'_{n+1}$ ; chaque $a_i$ est joint verticalement à $a'_i$ par un trait marqué $\lambda_i - 1$ ($\lambda_0 - 1, \lambda_1 - 1, \lambda_2 - 1, \ldots, \lambda_{n-1} - 1, \lambda_n - 1$), et en diagonale à $a'_{i+1}$ par un trait marqué $1$ (de $a_{-1}$ à $a'_0$, \ldots, de $a_n$ à $a'_{n+1}$) ; une accolade sous $a'_0, \ldots, a'_n$, prolongée d'un trait ondulé jusqu'à $a'_{n+1}$, avec un mot biffé
drawings.kind: two rows of vertices joined by labelled edges
drawings.notes: Top row a_{-1}, a_0, a_1 (asterisk above), a_2, ..., a_{n-1}, a_n under a brace V; bottom row a'_0, ..., a'_{n+1}; vertical edges a_i - a'_i labelled lambda_i - 1 and diagonals a_i - a'_{i+1} labelled 1. Below, a brace under a'_0 ... a'_n continued by a wavy stroke to a'_{n+1}. Omitted as struck: the word under it, scribbled out. The small labels are placed after the transcription (they are tiny on the page). Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous, la même rangée $a_{-1}, a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{n-1}, a_n$ et, décalée, $a'_0$, $a'_1$, \ldots, $a'_{n-1}$, $a'_n$, $a'_{n+1}$ ; seuls sont tracés les traits montant de $a'_i$ à $a_{i+1}$, marqués $\beta_0$, $\beta_1$, \ldots, $\beta_{n-1}$ ; un signe biffé après $a'_n$
drawings.kind: two rows of vertices joined by beta edges
drawings.notes: The top row a_{-1}, a_0, a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n-1}, a_n and, shifted, the bottom row a'_0, a'_1, ..., a'_{n-1}, a'_n, a'_{n+1}; only the strokes rising from a'_i to a_{i+1} are drawn, marked beta_0, beta_1, beta_{n-1}. Omitted as struck: the sign after a'_n, scribbled out. The label at the far right top (outside the figure) is left out. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
